Text.Text: Unbreakable Beast. You took everything that preserve had and you're still standing. Nothing left in there worth testing you against. Go hold something worth holding.
This one. Rancor, north pens, three years back. Near took my arm. I kept the arm. You haven't taken anything yet worth naming. Come back when you have.

Something took over my Tarn Jungle Preserve. Adepts, six of them. Toughen young beasts with beatings instead of trust, call it training. Go in, on Dathomir. Take the six down. Bring back the Unbreakable Beast Tarn Hunt Tally they're keeping score with.
Key's yours. North fence, same gap I've been meaning to weld shut for a year. Go in. Take what's coming. Come back standing.

Beat a beast enough, it stops flinching. Looks like toughness. It's just damage with nowhere left to feel. Real endurance holds because it chose to hold, not because it's too broken to notice pain anymore. Different thing entirely.
Only honest test there is. Not how hard you hit. How much you take and still stand up after. Anyone can swing once. Standing through the swing that should've dropped you, that's the whole discipline.
Every hit those adepts land gets scratched onto that tally. Proof, plain as anything, of exactly how they've been running my preserve. Bring it back whole and it stops being their scoreboard.
Six adepts still swinging. Tally's still with them.
You're upright. That's the whole test, passed. Let's see it.
Marked, every hit. That's evidence I can use. There's more standing between you and the rest of this preserve, if you've got the stomach.

Five specialists past the adepts. They've moved on from beatings to something with a needle in it, scent vial, dosed wrong on purpose to keep the beasts in constant pain. That's not toughening. That's just cruelty with a schedule. Take the five down. Bring me the Unbreakable Beast Beast-Pen Scent Vial.
Same gap in the fence. Deeper pens this time. Watch your footing near the troughs; they've let the ground rot.

Dosed to keep pain constant, low enough the beast can't rest, high enough it never toughens right. Bring that vial back whole and I've got proof of exactly what they've been dosing my animals with. Proof holds up better than my word alone.

Beatings leave marks people ask questions about. A needle's quieter. Same cruelty, harder to prove, which is exactly why they switched. Doesn't make it toughening. Makes it worse, honestly, because at least a beating ends.

No. Pain that never lets up isn't a test, it's just damage on a drip. My beasts endure because they trust the hand holding the line, not because the line never stops hurting. That trust is the whole difference between unbreakable and just broken slowly.
Five specialists, still dosing my pens. Bring that vial back.
You look like you took a few doses yourself. Hand it over.
That vial's proof enough on its own. Whoever's running this operation just made my case for me. Good work. Rest up.

Warden holds the deep pens. His hide's the reason blades bounce off him instead of biting, years of taking hits on purpose until nothing gets through clean anymore. One blade against that just wears its edge down for nothing. Bring friends who can take a hit themselves, not just deal one. Take him down. Bring me the Unbreakable Beast Clawed Alpha Totem.
Same gap. Deep pens past the rotted troughs. Bring people who can stand there and keep standing, not just people who hit hard once.

Took hits on purpose, for years, past any sense of it. Somewhere in there he stopped choosing to endure and started just being unable to feel it anymore. That's the difference between him and me, and it's the whole reason he's dangerous now.

Alpha totem marks the toughest bloodline in the pens, the one every other animal learns to hold from. He's got it clawed to pieces because he clawed the real bloodline apart himself, replaced it with whatever survives beating instead of whatever endures honestly. Bring it back whole and the real line's proven again.

Because one blade tires before his hide does. Simple as that. Bring friends who can take a hit and keep standing, and he's got three fights instead of one easy one, and none of you tire out at the same time he does. That's the whole trick to a hide like his. Outlast it in numbers, since you can't outlast it alone.
Warden's hide is still holding. Bring friends who can take a hit.
Everybody still standing? Good sign. Let's see the totem.
Whole. That's the real bloodline proven again, finally. Not bad, for people who could take a hit. Rest up. The ones who taught him that trick are next.

Four of them run the deep floor now, inner circle, the ones who taught the warden that his hide should stop feeling anything at all. Bring your people back. Four of them hitting at once is its own kind of endurance test. Take them down. Bring me the Unbreakable Beast Preserve Keeper's Token.
Same gap. Deepest part of the preserve. Stand together. Four of them hitting from four sides tests whether your people can hold a line as much as it tests you.

Taught him to stop feeling it. That's their whole doctrine down there: pain isn't something you endure, it's something you stop noticing. Difference between that and real endurance is everything. One's a choice you keep making. The other's just numbness with good posture.

That token's proof of who's allowed to run the deep floor, sign off on the pens, all of it. They minted fakes to cover for each other. One real token, and every fake signature they've made gets thrown out with it.

Beast holds for the master. Master holds for the beast. Neither one's numb to the other, and neither one stops choosing it, hit after hit. That's the whole bond, shared both directions. Not one thing enduring alone. Two things enduring together.
Four of them still running the deep floor. Bring the token back.
Your people still standing beside you. Good. Let's see the token.
Whole. Deep floor's mine to sign again. One name left down there, and he's the one who taught all four of them to stop feeling anything. You're ready for that.

Last one. The master's hide doesn't just stop feeling it. It doesn't break, period, not the way the warden's doesn't break, not the way anything in this preserve doesn't break. He built that out of the same endurance I've spent my life teaching, and pointed it at anyone who questioned him. Bring your people. All of them. His hide answers to a lot of hits landing together or it doesn't answer to anything. No token this time. Him going down, and staying down, is the whole proof.
Then go. All your people, together, same gap in the fence. His hide's felt one hit at a time for years and shrugged it off. Give it a lot of hits, all at once, for once.

Warden stopped feeling it. He stopped needing to feel it in the first place. That's further along the same road, and it's exactly what I've spent my whole life teaching, done right, for the wrong reasons. You've been building the true version this whole trial. He's the corrupted end of the same road.

Because one hit, however hard, is still one hit, and his hide's outlasted worse alone. A dozen hits, all at once, from every side, and there's no single point for that endurance to brace against anymore. That's the whole math of taking down something built not to break.

It means what it always meant. Beast holds for master, master holds for beast, both of you choosing it every single hit, never numb to each other even when you're numb to everything else. That's what he lost somewhere in all this. Don't lose it yourself.
His hide's still standing. Bring everyone you've got.
Preserve's gone quiet. Even the pens have stopped fighting the fences. Tell me he's down.

Then he's down, and staying down, which is the whole proof right there. You took everything that preserve had to give and you're still standing, same as I've always measured it. That's the unbreakable bond, both ways, held all the way through. Go hold something worth holding.
Back to standing.
I'll take the six down and bring your tally.
What do you mean, toughen with beatings?
What does endurance actually test?
What's this tally worth?
Not yet.
Here's the Unbreakable Beast Tarn Hunt Tally.
Back to standing.
I'll take the five down and bring the vial.
What's in that vial exactly?
Why move from beatings to needles?
Can a beast under that pain still endure honestly?
Give me a day.
Here's the Unbreakable Beast Beast-Pen Scent Vial.
Back to standing.
I'll bring friends who can take a hit too.
How'd his hide get like that?
What does the alpha totem prove?
Why do blades bounce off him specifically?
Haven't got the right friends yet.
Here's the Unbreakable Beast Clawed Alpha Totem, whole.
Back to standing.
We'll take the four together and hold.
What did they teach the warden, exactly?
What's this keeper's token prove?
What does an unbreakable bond actually share?
My people need to rest first.
Here's the Unbreakable Beast Preserve Keeper's Token, whole.
Back to standing.
All of us, together, against him.
How's his endurance different from the warden's?
Why does it take all of us to break one hide?
What does an unbreakable bond mean, once he's gone?
Not till everyone's ready.
He's down. Staying down.
